diagnosis: The actuator cache management endpoint purges secondary cache regions by tenantId selector without verifying whether the operator belongs to that specific tenant or holds system-level admin rights. A tenant operator can flush pricing and inventory caches of competitor tenants during flash sales, causing severe database contention and degraded responsiveness.
